description_en: Performs a pre-upgrade check before a major engine version upgrade for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
description_zh: 该接口用于执行RDS MySQL及RDS PostgreSQL大版本升级前检查
name: UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The target instance major engine version. The value must be greater than the current instance version
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例版本，必须大于当前实例版本
parameters.name: target_major_version

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade mode. Valid values:

zeroDownTimeUpgrade: zero-downtime migration.
inPlaceUpgrade: in-place deployment.
greenBlueDeployment: blue-green deployment
parameters.help_zh:
升级模式。取值：

zeroDownTimeUpgrade：零停机。
inPlaceUpgrade：本地升级。
greenBlueDeployment：蓝绿部署
parameters.name: upgrade_mode
